description: AI-based report summarization configuration for civic issue reporting

pothole.description: Road surface depression or hole that can cause vehicle damage or accidents

road_damage.description: General road surface damage including cracks, erosion, and deterioration

garbage_collection.description: Issues related to garbage collection, waste accumulation, and bin overflow

illegal_dumping.description: Unauthorized disposal of waste, construction debris, or garbage in public areas

street_light.description: Street light malfunction, damage, or absence causing dark areas

water_leakage.description: Water pipe leaks, bursts, or seepage causing water accumulation

drainage_block.description: Blocked or clogged drains, gutters, and sewers causing overflow

tree_falling_risk.description: Risk of tree or branch falling causing danger to life and property

sewage_overflow.description: Sewage or wastewater overflow creating health hazards and foul conditions

park_maintenance.description: Park and playground maintenance issues including broken equipment and cleanliness

water_supply_issue.description: Issues with water supply including shortage, low pressure, or contamination

hi: विकलांग व्यक्ति प्रवेश नहीं कर सकता
mr: विकलांग व्यक्ती प्रवेश करू शकत नाही

other.description: Catch-all category for issues not covered by main categories

injury.description: Any mention of physical injury or harm to people

death.description: Any mention of death or fatalities

people_affected.description: Indicates multiple people are affected by the issue

long_untreated.description: Issue has been pending or untreated for a long time

days_weeks.description: References to recent time periods (days to weeks)

months_years.description: References to longer time periods (months to years)

intensity.description: Words that indicate the intensity or severity of an issue

quantity.description: Words that indicate the quantity or number of issues/people affected
